an4.54:2.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave chavo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasaṭi?
an4.54:2.2: Idha bhikkhave sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātī adinnādāyī kāmesu micchācārī musāvādī pisuṇāvāco pharusāvāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālū vyāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko dussīlo pāpadhammo maccheramalapariyuṭṭhena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ,
an4.54:2.3: bhariyā pi 'ssa hoti pāṇatipātinī adinnādāyinī kāmesu micchācarinī musāvādinī pisuṇāvācā pharusāvācā samphappalāpinī abhijjhālunī vyāpannacittā micchādiṭṭhikā dussilā pāpadhammā maccheramalapariyutthena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.54:2.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave chavo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati. 3.
an4.54:3.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave chavo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati?
an4.54:3.2: Idha bhikkhave sāmiko hoti pāṇātipāti adinnādāyī . . . samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ,
an4.54:3.3: bhariyā khvassa pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā adinnādānā paṭiviratā kāmesu micchācārā paṭiviratā musāvādā paṭiviratā pisuṇāya vācāya paṭiviratā pharusāya vācāyā paṭiviratā samphappalāpā paṭiviratā na abhijjhālunī avyāpannacittā sammādiṭṭhikā sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā vigatāmalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati anakkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.54:3.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave chavo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati. 4.
an4.54:4.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave devo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati?
an4.54:4.2: Idha bhikkhave sāmiko hoti pāṇatipātā paṭivirato . . . sīlavā kalyāṇadhammo vigatamalamaccherana cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati anakkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānam,
an4.54:4.3: bhariyā khvassa hoti pāṇātapātinī . . . micchādiṭṭhikā dussīlā pāpadhammā maccheramalapariyuṭṭhitena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati akkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.54:4.4: Evaṃ kho bhikkhave devo chavāya saddhiṃ saṃvasati. 5.
an4.54:5.1: Kathañ ca bhikkhave devo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati?
an4.54:5.2: Idha bhikkhave sāmiko hoti pāṇātipātā paṭivirato . . . sīlavā kalyāṇadhammā vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati anakkosakaparibhāsako samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ,
an4.54:5.3: bhariyā pi 'ssa hoti pāṇātipātā paṭiviratā . . . sammādiṭṭhikā sīlavatī kalyāṇadhammā vigatamalamaccherena cetasā agāraṃ ajjhāvasati anakkosikaparibhāsikā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ.
an4.54:5.4: Evaṃ bho bhikkhave devo deviyā saddhiṃ saṃvasati.
an4.54:5.5: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro saṃvāsā ti. 7.
